notes.title: Version 4.08 live!!
notes.notes:
The latest update is now live!

I am very pleased to announce that the new build is live! Backers will have access very shortly, please bear with me while I get codes out.

This is another big step in development adding non VR play, game controllers and much more. It is also a very exciting stage as it has paved the way for the next round of development to focus on gameplay! We now have a very nice looking galaxy which I will now start filling with things to do!

I hope you all enjoy the new features, and please do keep spreading the word to anyone you think would enjoy the game! A reminder that alpha access is right here if you aren't yet signed up to play the alphas - https://www.patreon.com/c/FirstTimeGames

The patch notes....


Non VR play!
Inter Solar 83 is finally available to everyone, not just those with VR headsets!

HOTAS and game controller support.
The No.1 most requested feature, you can now just a HOTAS or other game controller(s) to fly your ship. Available in both VR and non VR play.

Control remapping
Set up any controller or keyboard input to a huge range of ship functions.
(this will also allow you to set up voice attack or similar third party software).

Overhauled star map
The star map should now load instantly (no more game freezes) and has had a full graphical overhaul.

New music
A much larger selection of fantastic 80s inspired tracks bring extra atmosphere to the game.

New ship locator compass
Tured of losing your ship on the surface of planets? Just use the handy new pointer!

Updated wrist computer.
New graphics and features to allow interation with the compass, bindings and graphics menu.

Updated save system.
The auto save now saves everything, from inventory contents to ammo count.

New graphics
From new hyperspace effects to an updated space suit.

New menus
An overhaul of the main menu to make things slicker and easier to use. VR and Non VR.

Many bug fixes
A lot of persistent bugs have now been fixed, along with crushing some new ones that turned up.

Optimisation
A sweep of the game tuning various features to improve framerate for VR and non VR players.

notes.title: New update now live! Saving and new warning system.
notes.notes:
New update now live!

This is largely a code update to add a very important feature, game saving! In this first iteration the game now auto-saves each time you jump to a new system, meaning you no longer have to re-start your journey every time you play. In the future a more flexible save system will be developed, but hopefully this first step will allow you all to get much more out of the game! (maybe you'll finally get to that nebula).

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] New save system implemented
[*] New warning system coded
[*] New model for warning display
[*] New physics system for dynamic objects
[*] new sounds added for various interactions
[*] Updated the main menu
[*] Added new transmission text for beacons
[/list]


Bug fixes
Sound fixed for wrist computer
Helmet shadow no longer blocks light in air lock
Various minor fixes/glitch tidy

notes.title: Version 4.03 released! Scanning, Navigating…and Dying!
notes.notes:
I've very pleased to announce that version 4.03 is now live! This adds many new features, including...

[list]
[*] On-Board System Scanner: Players can now access a cutting-edge (for 1983) system scanner, allowing for detailed identification of nearby celestial bodies, a new targeting and navigation system..and even the chance to find mysterious distress calls from amongst the stars.
[*] Overhauled Orbital Physics: A complete rework of orbital mechanics brings the game’s physics engine closer to reality, offering more accurate gravitational effects and flight dynamics.
[*] Starmap Overhaul: The starmap now includes improved graphics, system details, and new features that make exploration and planning interstellar routes more intuitive.
[*] Revamped Spacecraft Interiors: Players can immerse themselves in their spacecraft like never before with new models, enhanced graphics, and improved interior layout to make ship control more intuitive.
[*] Dynamic Temperature System Overhaul – The game’s dynamic temperature system has been refined to deliver more realistic environmental effects. 
[*] Temperature Effects on Ship – Ships are now more susceptible to environmental hazards such as extreme heat and cold, impacting performance and requiring players to monitor and manage ship systems to prevent catastrophic failures.
[*] New Control Panels, Interactions, and Sound Effects – New control panels and interactions enhance the tactile feel of piloting the spacecraft, while a range of new sound effects provide an auditory experience that deepens immersion.
[*] Player Death and "Game Over" Scenarios – For the first time, Inter Solar 83 introduces player death mechanics. Harsh space environments, critical system failures, and plain old pilot error now come with real stakes, adding intensity to every flight.
[*] Bug Fixes and Improvements – In addition to these major updates, the game has undergone significant performance improvements, fixing bugs and optimizing gameplay for a smoother, more stable experience.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the update! As ever I would like to thank everyone who has supported the project via the Patreon. I literally couldn't do it without your help, and fantastic input to help shape the game.

notes.title: August patch now live!
notes.notes:
I'm very pleased to announce that the latest build is now live.

This adds many new features to the game including...

•	Oxygen management
•	Wearable Spacesuit (don’t go out without your helmet!)
•	Overhauled VR camera system
•	Complete lighting overhaul
•	New graphics and models for spacecraft interior
•	New control panels, interactions and sound effects.
•	New environmental sound effects
•	a huge list of bug fixes!

I hope you enjoy the new challenges that come with managing your air supplies, along with the power and fuel. I'm already working on the next update that will add more layers of gameplay to the project.

notes.title: July Patch
notes.notes:
July patch now live! This adds temperature and power management features to the game

[list]
[*] Dynamic temperature system
[*] Temperature effects on ship
[*] Climate control system including new control panel, interactions and sound effects.
[*] Power consumption system - you now need to monitor power use, and recharge to avoid your ship shutting down completely!
[*] Updated power unit readout screen
[*] Updated sound effects for ship engines
[*] New environmental sound effects
[*] New dynamic star light and heat - distance and line of sight now effect heat absorbed from sunlight. You will notice dramatic drops in temperature when orbiting on the dark side of a planet.
[*] Updated lighting system to correctly block sunlight when in shadow of a planet.
[*] fixed bug with suns showing through landscape
[*] many other minor bug fixes
[/list]
